title: Dialectica Raises Client Service Starting Pay in Greece by Up to 25%; Headcount Passes 1,600
summary: Dialectica announced it is raising base pay for its Client Service team in Greece by up to 25%, effective September 1, 2026, for existing staff and future hires. The company said that, combined with earlier changes, the total remuneration package has risen by 40% within a year, and that it now has more than 1,600 employees worldwide. Founder and CEO George Tsarouchas said the firm consistently invests in Greek talent.
whyItMatters: Associate-heavy expert networks compete hard for graduate talent; a sizable pay reset in Dialectica's home market, alongside headcount passing 1,600, signals continued hiring-led growth.
